rules.name: source modifier scope

rules.name: physical-role reference

rules.name: replacement descriptor

rules.name: typed addition and optional fragments
rules.definition: ALSO with a completed ReplacementSpec placement fragment adds a guardless optional fragment to the old role choice set; with a provenance relation or requirement it merely adds that relation. This dispatch is a paid convention, not logic inherent in ALSO.

rules.name: guardless old selector
rules.definition: SELECT_EXECUTE_ONE consumes a nonempty written alternative set, chooses one member and executes exactly that placement fragment, returning a new SelectionOutput ID U. Both admissible choices are retained as hypothetical program traces; no selected material is present in the initial state.

rules.name: availability condition
rules.definition: WHEN AVAILABLE(KindA,Actor) creates a guard from the explicitly written KindA and actor; in the finite contrast/preparation production it scopes the subsequent preparation/replacement/retention/release instructions to the closing work-complete production. Unknown controls block this scope. It is not a CoReMA lacks-primary guard.

rules.name: new selector/assembly macro
rules.definition: SELECT_ASSEMBLE_FINISH takes the written ReplacementSpec, written ready matching-kind sample, prior carrier hosting plan and common materials under the availability scope. It resolves the slot, selects the proposed sample, substitutes in the plan, places the resulting material group, and encloses the assembly. Five paid internal steps; returns U=(selectedMaterialID, targetRoleID, carrierID, assemblyID, ancestry).

rules.name: selected-output resolver
rules.definition: SELECTED_OUTPUT_REF returns the most recent completed SelectionOutput ID produced by R07/R09 in this unit. Planned descriptions, prepared samples, title metadata and ambient current-part registers are not eligible. Zero completed outputs is unresolved; competing outputs without an explicit ordering is unresolved.

rules.name: old output piping
rules.definition: The selector output is an explicit program-expression argument to the adjacent ENCLOSE; ENCLOSE returns SealedSelectionOutput whose selectedOutputID is U. Adjacent WEAR consumes that returned record, not a current-material register. This source-order dataflow convention is separately paid.

rules.name: retain topic and hosted relation
rules.definition: Actor Uref RETAIN HOSTED_ON Uref CarrierRef requires both Urefs equal, and requires U.material hosted by the named carrier. It appends a persistence requirement without creating a placement or efficacy state. This is one downstream consumer.

rules.name: later handling requirement
rules.definition: AFTER_HANDLING Carrier RETAIN Uref SAME_POSE adds a later-stage requirement for the very same U.material and its established carrier pose. It does not assert a performed handling event or automatic successful outcome. This is a distinct downstream consumer.

rules.name: compound and base identities
rules.definition: COMMON_BASE, BINDER and physical slot are separate constituents; same source kind does not merge individuals or inherit traits. HAS_BASE preserves the same base identity after substitution. Release refers to the completed assembly belonging to U.

rules.name: goals and ascriptions
rules.definition: Finite goal-state and purpose productions quote enclosed states/operations and purposes; no physical effect from quoted state. Attributed social/protective properties remain goals/ascriptions, never observed efficacy.

rules.name: whole input conservation
rules.definition: Every source group and boundary must be assigned an analysis and consumed once in a complete production. Marked/nonlowercase strings and unbound whole forms remain UNKNOWN. Any possible unknown control/argument blocks complete compilation; no deletion, prefer-reader repair or implicit output bridging.

rules.name: strict opaque-kind declaration frames
